Latin word

temperī

adverb

in good time, early enough; on time, at the right time

In this lexicon

  • in good time

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 89; Plaut.; Cic.

  • on time

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Capt. 191: Veniās temperī; Traupman 33, 83, 89; M-O s.v. time: on time

Examples

  • Tum temperī profectī sunt.

    Then they set off in good time.Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

    In the entry for in good time

  • Numquid vīs? — Veniās temperī. — Memorem monēs.

    “Anything else?” — “Mind you come on time.” — “No need to remind me.”Plaut. Capt. 191

    In the entry for on time

  • Vēnistī quidem temperī.

    Indeed, you’re on time.Traupman 83
